doc: Single list of the CI screenshots, in the order ShotScenario signals them (Assets/MinikUsta/Presentation.Core/Shots/ShotScenario.cs; a unit test keeps both equal). The Playwright script waits for '[minikShot] shot:<name>' lines and saves <viewport>/<name>.png. `sequences` are the motion windows (P4B-08): the script photographs the page between '[minikShot] seq:<name>:begin' and ':end' (the game runs at `motionScale` of real time inside them, for `motionMs` game milliseconds; `focus` = the picture fractions where the animation is, used for the changed-pair count and the strip crop), writes <viewport>/seq_<name>_strip.png and the frame statistics into manifest.json; a sequence comes right before the shot named in `before`.
